import os,json,platform,subprocess,urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/srv/projects/skill-universal')
candidates=[root/'tools/hopper',root/'tools/hopper-6.6.1',root/'tools/rea-providers/hopper',root/'current',root/'.runtime/npm/rea',Path('/opt/hopper')]
def kind(p):
 return 'link' if p.is_symlink() else 'directory' if p.is_dir() else 'file' if p.is_file() else 'absent'
info={'platform':platform.platform(),'machine':platform.machine(),'locations':{str(p):kind(p) for p in candidates},'apt_hopper':None}
r=subprocess.run(['dpkg-query','-W','hopper'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=8)
info['apt_hopper']={'exit':r.returncode,'summary':r.stdout.strip()[:120]}
p=root/'tools'
info['matching_names_in_tools']=sorted(x.name for x in p.iterdir() if 'hopper' in x.name.lower()) if p.is_dir() else []
paths=['/usr/bin/Xvfb','/usr/bin/dpkg-deb','/usr/bin/gpg','/usr/bin/curl']
info['tools_available']={q:Path(q).is_file() for q in paths}
url='https://www.hopperapp.com/include/files-api.php?request=releases&public=true'
try:
 req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
 with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=12) as response:
  info['vendor_feed_http']=response.status
  raw=response.read(150000)
  data=json.loads(raw)
  content=json.dumps(data,ensure_ascii=True)
  info['vendor_feed_mentions_6_6_1']='6.6.1' in content
  info['vendor_feed_mentions_deb']='.deb' in content
except Exception as ex:info['vendor_feed_error']=type(ex).__name__
print(json.dumps(info,separators=(',',':')))
